<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl groups in the unknown molecule. The available tools can provide NMR spectra for the sample at hand. By retrieving the 13C NMR spectrum, we can count the distinct carbon signals in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm). Each methyl carbon gives one signal, so counting those peaks will give the number of methyl groups.</thought>
